name: Nether Earth ZS Edition '99: stage 2: print
summary: The 64-column print routine and its variables.

entries.name: PrintChar
entries.summary: Print the character or control code A at PrintCol, PrintRow

entries.name: PrintFontArgument
entries.summary: $17's bytes: low into PrintFont, high into PrintFont+1 (not reached: the text has no $17)

entries.name: PrintArgumentDone
entries.summary: One argument byte less to come

entries.name: PrintControl
entries.summary: A control code below $20: LF here, the others in PrintControlRest

entries.name: PrintNewRow
entries.summary: LF: the next print row (also after column 63)

entries.name: PrintControlRest
entries.summary: CR, AT, TAB, back, $17; any other code is ignored

labels.comment: a glyph: HL' = PrintFont + the character
rows 24 and on are not drawn
HL = the row's screen address + column / 2
even column: the left nibble ($F0), odd: the right ($0F)

labels.name: PrintGlyphRow
labels.comment: 8 rows: the glyph's bits under the mask into the screen byte
the next column; at 64 the next row

labels.name: PrintArgument
labels.comment: a byte after a $16 or a $17: AT's column, row, or the font address
$16: the column into PrintCol, then the row into PrintRow

labels.name: PrintArgumentStore
labels.comment: HL = the slot: PrintArgsLeft bytes below HL

labels.name: PrintArgumentFont
labels.comment: $17: the two bytes into PrintFont
CR: column 0

labels.name: PrintAt
labels.comment: $16 AT: two arguments to come

labels.name: PrintTab
labels.comment: $09: the next multiple of 8

labels.name: PrintBack
labels.comment: $08: one column back
the carry is CP $08's (clear): never returns here

labels.name: PrintFontCode
labels.comment: $17: two arguments (the font address)

labels.name: PrintIgnore
labels.comment: any other code below $20

labels.name: PrintCol
labels.comment: The print column, 0-63

labels.name: PrintRow
labels.comment: the print row, 0-23 (more: not drawn)

labels.name: PrintArgsLeft
labels.comment: the argument bytes still to come after $16 or $17

labels.name: PrintCode
labels.comment: the control code waiting for its arguments ($16 or $17)

labels.name: PrintCurrent
labels.comment: the byte being printed

labels.name: PrintMask
labels.comment: $F0 (even column) or $0F (odd)

labels.name: PrintFont
labels.comment: The font: glyph row r of character c at PrintFont + c + 256 x r (Font64 once IntroMain set it; on the disk $3C00, the ROM's font, which is not in this layout)
